data.name: Qualities.Summary.5b19dbcd-fb69-4a02-a25a-7ac5342ca576
data.value: You spot patterns and connect clues. The bonus applies to analytical tasks such as investigating evidence or solving puzzles, not every Logic test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84305e09-f8d5-4a82-8257-0119b8c3f926
data.value: You move quietly and avoid attracting attention. This improves Sneaking tests; it does not make you invisible.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.db579224-99c7-48e0-84ab-77a987a84f4a
data.value: Your flexible joints help you slip out of restraints. The bonus applies to Escape Artist tests.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.225f0d31-8c03-4283-9a22-558ab01a6c47
data.value: Running and acrobatics come naturally to you. You gain bonuses to Running and Gymnastics, rather than a general increase to physical attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.58e3d62a-2073-4af5-b8e0-00c446b3a5ab
data.value: Choose a skill with exceptional potential. Its maximum rating increases; this does not grant a free skill level or bonus dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2ac8a95a-a4d0-4bef-a2f2-dcde020258cf
data.value: Choose an attribute other than Edge. Its natural maximum increases, giving you room to improve it further; its current value does not rise automatically.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c734e46a-d391-45a6-b022-6f18db5019f1
data.value: You grew up speaking two native languages. The additional native-language slot is not a bonus to every language skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9f25cc0a-c47c-49dd-953c-8fe60628bae8
data.value: You make a strong first impression. The social skill bonus applies when meeting someone for the first time, not to every later conversation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b7866fb4-3747-4caf-9240-69cbdd79ce78
data.value: You keep functioning despite injuries. Wound penalties start later; damage is still recorded normally and this does not heal you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.78f7456d-78b8-461e-a2b2-bd0d63c48712
data.value: Your potential for good fortune is unusually high. Your Edge maximum increases, but you still need to buy the extra point.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9d3be1d9-1309-45e7-8bd9-1f5a3ede3522
data.value: You recall information and details more easily. This improves memory tests rather than granting knowledge you never learned.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.291efdb6-a8b8-49ce-b2be-72f9d3f8a243
data.value: You recover well from injuries and exhaustion. Bonuses apply to healing you, including the listed Heal spell test; they do not improve healing other people.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00cc6499-db13-447e-8116-278d317a9e31
data.value: You withstand punishment better. The damage-resistance bonus helps you resist incoming damage; it is not extra armor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.18d2a522-6460-4654-916b-a96631f11323
data.value: Adds one overflow box per level, extending survival after Physical damage fills the monitor; it does not prevent unconsciousness or heal injuries.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9d53e1e4-3f31-40cb-bfbe-4b94f5ba757e
data.value: Your talent combines magician abilities with adept powers. Choose and pay for the permitted spells, skills and powers in the Magic step; this entry does not grant every ability for free.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.55247bdc-c313-4614-ae15-5012308096ff
data.value: You channel magic into adept powers. Select your powers in the Magic step; being an adept does not by itself make you a spellcaster.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c4b35412-bd91-45b4-b428-29da7edd5ff4
data.value: You access the Matrix through a living persona and Resonance abilities. The Computer bonus shown here is specifically for Matrix Perception.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.25356bae-efcc-46c6-9c4f-66909b9b7233
data.value: An unpleasant reputation precedes you. Your Notoriety increases and can affect how others react to your runner.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1bad26cf-9d67-4bb1-9b4f-e9c80d668651
data.value: You notice details others miss, both with your senses and when reading an aura. The bonuses apply to Perception and Assensing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e96c7280-b9b0-4112-8b65-a3568c7ca13e
data.value: Stress can make your hands shake. When triggered, an Agility + Body test determines whether you keep them steady; while shaking, Agility-based tests take a −2 dice penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ba27345f-0e68-4660-9b76-2b999c3a4161
data.value: Tests involved in directing a vehicle lose 2 dice because you are prone to mishaps at the controls. This is a vehicle-control penalty, not a general penalty to every action while travelling.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0a7bcb95-dd9c-4e3e-ab0a-291a352ac1d4
data.value: You are especially vulnerable to disease. Pathogens affect you at increased Power; this is a drawback, not a resistance bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8ba2830a-3f10-4877-9752-93be051b205b
data.value: A particular social situation causes you intense stress. In that situation, Leadership and Etiquette tests are more likely to glitch.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5150f4f0-5193-4f02-8914-d70e831e3567
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Gymnastics instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1d0c4278-501d-456f-ab63-69afee6fbf95
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Agility instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b5f6d958-2563-431b-a7a4-a9028a9f0277
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Perception instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0c23861e-36d1-4454-b327-0d8118d02d60
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Charisma instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.58e6a651-cdd7-4144-a2cc-4cee24526e92
data.value: Your Physical limit increases, allowing more hits to count on tests capped by that limit. This does not raise your physical attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b9f1dbeb-1728-4250-a066-4773f758fe6a
data.value: Your Social limit increases, allowing more hits to count on tests capped by that limit. This is not a bonus to every social dice pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e160111a-5fe3-4154-9d5a-82330c9b32fc
data.value: You resist pathogens more effectively, whether exposure comes through contact, ingestion, inhalation or injection. Resistance helps with the test; it is not complete immunity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c74c9ed8-a917-4809-9e8a-5717dd16619b
data.value: You resist toxins more effectively through all four exposure routes. The bonus applies to toxin resistance, not to damage resistance in general.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2b9a495d-b735-416b-a000-f648c3b4191a
data.value: Someone depends on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 10%; it does not grant extra starting money.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cc857826-3bb2-466d-987b-7d56a337bc08
data.value: Someone depends on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 20%; the extra expense continues with that lifestyle.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.066a2de9-1717-44ca-a8c6-90366890574a
data.value: Someone places substantial demands on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 30%, rather than charging a one-time fee.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.13fd45c3-e031-4452-8bf8-31829d2401f9
data.value: Your body handles augmentation poorly. Cyberware costs twice the normal Essence, and bioware is unavailable.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f0873c37-4f09-41cd-be81-88e8df5b42ae
data.value: Social training costs twice as many creation points or Karma. Social skill groups are unavailable, so you cannot use a group purchase to avoid those costs. Your Notoriety also increases.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d8362a78-54e9-4dbe-8388-6ba0a7b9df31
data.value: Academic, professional and technical learning is harder for you. The listed skills and specializations cost twice the normal Karma, and you cannot default in those categories. Technical skill-group training also costs more.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce939b04-5fc6-49e9-a747-9c9d1254449e
data.value: You may obtain one item with Availability up to 24. This is an exception to the availability restriction, not a free item; its normal price still matters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7706ce23-77c2-470f-bb7e-6a4e56fa78fe
data.value: Each level penalizes Logic/Intuition tests, defense, Surprise, memory, reading intentions and the listed magical and addiction resistances.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0c11aefb-2306-43e9-9588-a84a563e9025
data.value: Bony spikes make your unarmed attacks more dangerous. They add 2 to unarmed damage and change that damage to Physical.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.51ba5e67-f2fd-4149-b24c-9b502ed0e7c7
data.value: You gain a pair of additional arms. This describes extra limbs, not two additional actions or a blanket attack bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.23bfa65d-9241-4183-b7ea-0e2935e42f29
data.value: Cyberware integrates more easily with your body. Its Essence cost is 90% of normal; this does not reduce its nuyen price.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dcecd7e5-8cf1-4f83-89fa-177e28cfba03
data.value: Bioware integrates more easily with your body. Its Essence cost is 90% of normal; this does not reduce its nuyen price.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00c827f6-aaa7-4003-87c9-f14e36263252
data.value: You gain 2 dice to resist developing a new physical or psychological addiction. This does not grant the same bonus once that addiction already exists.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0ebdfce5-c613-4fd9-9763-cae2d21c2153
data.value: Your Essence contributes to your recovery. Add it to tests for healing Physical damage and recovering from Stun damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00ae8fce-15aa-4a7f-90e3-9336824a626e
data.value: You are more vulnerable to addiction: physical and psychological addiction resistance tests take a 2-dice penalty. It applies both before an addiction develops and when one already exists.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.919cc565-a5b6-4eda-addb-afa2e293af24
data.value: You read the room instinctively. Etiquette tests use Intuition as their attribute instead of the usual attribute; this does not change every social skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2c1aff52-95e2-43f5-98ea-c653c66b7ee7
data.value: People find your intentions harder to read. You gain 2 dice when resisting Judge Intentions; it does not improve your own ability to read someone else.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41416949-62eb-4638-9457-fd7e833cea58
data.value: You rely on reasoning in diplomatic negotiations. The Diplomacy specialization of Negotiation uses Logic instead of the usual attribute; other Negotiation specializations are unchanged.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e508350b-f61d-4878-bd6d-98f8c9e3588b
data.value: You gain Alter Ballistics as an alchemical spell. It is an alchemical option, not a permanent damage bonus to every firearm.

data.value: You cover ground faster. Your base walking and running multipliers become 3 and 6 times Agility, and each sprinting hit adds one extra meter. These are movement changes, not bonus dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5451c3da-b08c-4a63-899f-afb62bd50a57
data.value: Your legs improve running on land: the base running multiplier becomes six times Agility, and each sprinting hit adds one extra meter. This does not increase your walking multiplier.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c6a2aa0f-76fd-432b-85bb-3ef2c2857525

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f6a8d504-db7a-47eb-ace5-604de21c80fd
data.value: Essence loss reduces your special attribute at 20% of the normal rate. This modifier changes the attribute loss, not the Essence cost or nuyen price of an augmentation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.742caf46-a10b-4aa1-a6bc-a53feb99748c
data.value: You gain a free-spell allowance equal to half your Magic, rounded up. Those spells must have Touch range, including touch-area spells; this is not permission to choose spells at any range.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bbc6879e-b50d-4862-b85c-a86c5b9e5d67
data.value: You specialize in spellcasting. Your free-spell allowance follows your Spellcasting rating, and learning a new spell costs one less Karma. Summoning and Binding are unavailable.

data.value: Sunlight supplements your food needs; it does not replace eating. Lifestyle costs fall 10%. At night or in shade, Social tests lose 1 die. Incompatible with Nocturnal and skin or hair modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c16ecaf5-e57f-4aae-8ef9-b7df84626ac5
data.value: Increases unarmed damage, not attack dice, but penalizes Physical Active tests; requires a SURGE changeling.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6dae7800-8634-44e3-9aca-f5a18eb06b45
data.value: Enhances smell-based Perception only, without improving other senses; requires a SURGE changeling.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.059f4399-f3c4-40b0-a975-d7e29a2e412b
data.value: Webbing improves Swimming tests, not skill rating or underwater breathing; requires a SURGE changeling.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.db002182-a3c4-4c77-a615-7a878d227871
data.value: A metabolic condition slows movement and penalizes physical activities, including combat. Exertion causes faster and more severe fatigue.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5c067c2c-435e-40c8-ab76-e4ffe6a4f884
data.value: Physical differences: −2 dice for Physical Active skills except Perception; learned ratings stay unchanged. Double the usual metagenic social modifiers. Surgical correction requires buying off this drawback first.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9135118a-1085-4e31-9682-014c8b40c888
data.value: You are an adult with a child's or adolescent's physical appearance, affecting how others treat you. Physical condition monitor: 2 fewer boxes; Stun is unchanged. Custom armour and equipment increase lifestyle costs by 10%.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.856622a9-b28c-4ac7-8707-812a51fecf7a
data.value: Physical Active skill tests lose two dice. This affects test pools, not the learned ratings of those skills. Unlike the Quasimodo variant, this penalty does not exclude Perception.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b8b300d4-cf20-4652-8feb-2528030c6271
data.value: Healing you is slower: all healing tests lose 2 dice, including magical healing and Physical or Stun recovery. Apply the penalty once to the relevant test; do not combine Physical and Stun penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.73ded55c-3f96-4efa-bd03-cd9bdebeb303
data.value: Short arms reduce melee and unarmed Reach by 1. Non-Combat tests requiring arm or hand dexterity lose 1 die at the GM's discretion. This does not reduce Strength, damage or firearm range.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7653cadb-0092-4a94-9a17-9329fb4f6041
data.value: When you are not looking your best, Social Active skill tests lose one die per quality level, up to three levels. The penalty is conditional; your social skill ratings do not decrease.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0b28f554-8929-4b8b-b8c6-4203ca856b33
data.value: Addiction and toxin resistance suffer regardless of dependence type or exposure route; apply only the relevant penalty, not every listed case together.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5e75a946-b14e-488d-93ea-cd82e648286d
data.value: While inside a Matrix host, tests using the Stealth skill group lose two dice. The penalty does not apply to every physical-world Stealth test or lower your learned skill ratings.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.522dbfb5-5ea0-4707-a7e8-1ac777b3aff7
data.value: Your living persona's Attack increases by 2. This quality requires a technomancer and changes that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance, physical attributes or every Matrix test pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d40aee6b-80b7-43f5-b335-dabf8f1ad14d
data.value: Your living persona's Attack decreases by 1. This quality requires a technomancer and weakens that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance or all four persona attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.39139f84-b8ab-4523-ac02-851350e3f2b6
data.value: Your living persona's Data Processing increases by 2. This quality requires a technomancer and changes that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance, physical attributes or every Matrix test pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.64d430b1-6d6a-4abc-9ef8-3ddaee2352ce
data.value: Your living persona's Data Processing decreases by 1. This quality requires a technomancer and weakens that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance or all four persona attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.25d34c52-6927-44dd-85bd-684e9add1f89
data.value: Your living persona's Firewall increases by 2. This quality requires a technomancer and changes that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance, physical attributes or every Matrix test pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.a1530804-a35b-4d2f-ae3e-50d647016903
data.value: Your living persona's Firewall decreases by 1. This quality requires a technomancer and weakens that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance or all four persona attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.59436ccc-5e4b-481d-8d63-d3ba912f2d8a
data.value: Your living persona's Sleaze increases by 2. This quality requires a technomancer and changes that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance, physical attributes or every Matrix test pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cb5bd1e5-b9ef-434f-af17-0e7b4decaa46
data.value: Your living persona's Sleaze decreases by 1. This quality requires a technomancer and weakens that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance or all four persona attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.08c4dfad-3661-48d9-a265-43cce84e20d8
data.value: Creation only: up to 1 Essence of prototype bioware avoids Essence loss, but still costs nuyen. A required drawback grants no extra Karma.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0321887-df33-49d9-9d2e-e718eca9c7a0
data.value: Choose one optional infected power, with a possible drawback discount. Its effects and final cost depend on that choice; zero listed cost does not mean free.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.71511c8f-85f1-4e35-aeaa-be8fa3a45331
data.value: A technomancer may permanently fetter one sprite for unlimited services. Career cost equals its rating in Karma; the bond grants no free sprite.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d2873478-d265-45bb-8a9f-320b8d0d33d3
data.value: Improve Compiling and Decompiling Fault or Companion sprites. Submersion can conditionally recover cyberware-lost Resonance, not Essence or losses from bioware.

data.name: Qualities.Info.ChangedDefinition
data.value: This quality uses a different definition. Its full explanation is not available yet; any effects below come from this version.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.68cfe94a-fa7e-4129-a9b9-b5d73e3ced99
data.value: Using your off hand no longer incurs the off-hand penalty. This does not add dice to every attack or remove penalties for splitting your attention between multiple actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7d81f676-e523-4ec6-ae98-8d801f90b031
data.value: Your magical traces fade twice as quickly. Anyone assensing a signature you left takes a two-die penalty. This conceals your astral traces, not your physical presence, and requires the ability to leave magical signatures.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9cffd452-8489-48d5-888c-ac35459d9174
data.value: You are harder to remember or track among people. Magical and Matrix searches are unaffected; standing out removes the benefit.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4d5c22b9-4908-493d-a6f7-4ccc3066888c
data.value: Sustain one spell or complex form up to this quality's rating without its sustaining penalty; Drain and Fading still apply.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5c18a150-8e38-4f6d-b4f5-b1b674a3581e
data.value: Temporarily choose 20% more Speed or +1 Handling during vehicle combat or chases, and improve stunts. Extending the boost damages the vehicle.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0d0cb0fc-c79d-418e-9216-8a197369e52d
data.value: Add two dice when resisting fear or intimidation, including fear caused by magic or creature powers. This helps you keep your nerve; it does not make you immune or improve your own Intimidation attacks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2844e64e-f271-4ca7-bd58-0860b2db56c9
data.value: An elf, dwarf or ork can usually pass for human. Human prejudice against metahumans is treated as neutral in social tests, but people hostile to humans may react worse. Your actual metatype and its attributes do not change.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.27c7ea84-bfe4-47e1-8382-38d9a5c8e680
data.value: Improves temporary improvised repairs, subject to GM approval. Combining a vehicle boost with Gearhead burns out critical components.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.52648a83-1d2a-4b04-b7fc-ee5a62bce4f7
data.value: Your nervous system provides one point of natural biofeedback filtering. It stacks with a Biofeedback Filter program or a technomancer's Firewall. This protects against biofeedback, not ordinary physical attacks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.de12b672-f60a-486d-85f6-b94a80a058da
data.value: Your device use glitches more easily with each level, and Notoriety rises once. Implants are unaffected; this cannot sabotage others.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ced3fecf-2277-4b20-b1e0-894162ca9ae2
data.value: Choose a magical guide with individual benefits and demands. Its full profile is not yet explained here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c5311ee0-8a9b-41b9-857f-28541090968a
data.value: Choose a technomancer's Resonance guide with individual benefits and drawbacks. Its full profile is not yet explained here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.36429e96-89fa-4e37-a20a-61a8d35a92ac
data.value: Choose one eligible inherent AI program; its function depends on that program, whose full effects are not yet explained here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94a09a8d-d582-44f0-9f2c-71f7ba94e767
data.value: Your astral signatures last longer and are easier to read with Assensing; requires Magic, without changing the observer's dice pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bc5f41ca-1549-4367-9c12-afa403182f8c
data.value: Spending Edge can backfire while still consuming it. This reversal can occur only once per session.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.62c7ed8f-b534-41e3-84ac-29534826d476
data.value: Combat starts with half your opening Initiative score. Surprise and composure under fire also suffer; later Initiative rolls are normal.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.86b259fd-17c8-4ae5-b246-49782e7c5047
data.value: Penalizes one chosen, realistically used Matrix action that requires a test; other Matrix actions are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.a030d7e2-755b-4f71-b848-ad9772fba242
data.value: Your distinctive appearance or behavior makes you easier to remember, identify and track. Astral searches are unaffected; incompatible with Blandness.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0cf25fda-725b-49fd-a8cf-de589e938065
data.value: Restless sleep can slow Stun recovery and delay Edge refresh; successful rest still allows normal recovery.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.149e6bf7-a6b4-4893-b755-4d983372079c
data.value: Failed rest blocks Stun recovery and delays Edge refresh; successful sleep still allows normal recovery.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b2210e9a-ab8a-45f9-b5db-13f6923c2d22
data.value: AR, VR and simsense disorient you, penalizing tests using those interfaces, including smartlinks, simrigs and image links.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9ba327d2-38c5-4a25-ae44-25e98f0bbf03
data.value: Physical and Stun injuries impose wound penalties sooner, without reducing either condition monitor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7036225b-d0f0-4c86-85b7-cc4d46943113
data.value: Humans can pose as elves without changing metatype or attributes. Discovery risks hostility from elves and prejudiced humans.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.075447a2-5730-4750-a19f-1a5c6086903d
data.value: A human or elf imitates orks, risking hostility when discovered. Appearance does not change your metatype or attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.40c06974-a85b-4f2b-9558-51c140c16d87
data.value: One chosen spirit type is hostile to you. Summoning and binding it become harder, and it resists your banishing more strongly.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ea7cced4-a201-44a2-9a1b-e10180b1df81
data.value: Monthly cravings; unresisted withdrawal: mental-based tests -2 dice for psychological dependence, physical-based tests -2 for physical dependence. No persistent social penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9a52a300-4d90-4b1f-a113-d0e40a410063
data.value: Fortnightly cravings; unresisted withdrawal: mental-based tests -4 dice for psychological dependence, physical-based tests -4 for physical dependence. No persistent social penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b5fa94e6-03fb-4d00-b368-86c318f79c09
data.value: Weekly cravings; unresisted withdrawal: mental-based tests -4 dice for psychological dependence, physical-based tests -4 for physical dependence. Social tests always -2.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0886bbb3-f5a9-4583-bcea-d6723889c80d
data.value: Daily cravings; unresisted withdrawal: mental-based tests -6 dice for psychological dependence, physical-based tests -6 for physical dependence. Social tests always -3.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b7841930-0c7b-4be4-b1cf-86debc41aa95
data.value: Allergen exposure: -2 dice on Physical tests and -1 to resist attacks using it; no ongoing damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e89db285-8db9-4a9c-80cb-94d87b86a80b
data.value: Allergen exposure: -2 dice on Physical tests and -1 to resist attacks using it; no ongoing damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f3ad08be-a7a4-4965-bb38-f8db9016c94e
data.value: Allergen exposure: -4 dice on Physical tests and -2 to resist attacks using it; no ongoing damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.90188ca7-0ccb-4198-b199-dcf33e029d74
data.value: Allergen exposure: -4 dice on Physical tests and -2 to resist attacks using it; no ongoing damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84a43000-9ae4-4391-b156-d5fbc9a092de
data.value: Allergen exposure: -4 dice on all tests, -3 to resist allergen attacks, plus ongoing unresisted Physical damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.df14fb6e-456d-4d24-83e8-b1c97576dce2
data.value: Allergen exposure: -4 dice on all tests, -3 to resist allergen attacks, plus ongoing unresisted Physical damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cfdc255a-bb46-4d9c-8960-e4181455f4e3
data.value: Allergen exposure: actions -6 dice, resistance to allergen attacks -4; faster unresisted Physical damage. First Aid, Medicine or magic can stop shock.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8a40007a-9876-4998-a7c9-047248cfbc52
data.value: Allergen exposure: actions -6 dice, resistance to allergen attacks -4; faster unresisted Physical damage. First Aid, Medicine or magic can stop shock.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9ac85feb-ae1e-4996-8514-3570d411e1d5
data.value: National SIN: 15% gross-income tax, mandatory broadcast and police access to identity and biometrics; false identities do not erase the record.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d9479e5c-d44a-45b9-8fb4-d1e08a9487b2
data.value: Criminal SIN replaces your former identity: mandatory broadcast, 15% gross-income tax, police scrutiny, and restricted employment and access.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.318d2edd-833b-48c5-a3e1-343bf03848a5
data.value: Limited corporate SIN: 20% gross-income tax, extraction risk and distrust, without leadership privileges.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e00623e1-54b0-4a91-b234-3c7e141deef4
data.value: Full corporate SIN: 10% gross-income tax and corporate records, with hostility in the shadows; no free corporate resources.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d6843e67-0837-4353-a5db-f4c320560ddb
data.value: Bias against a common group: social tests with its members -2 dice; their Negotiation against you +2. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9a76f104-a472-4b6a-b5b7-a8f5248f65a9
data.value: Open prejudice against a common group: social tests with its members -4 dice; their Negotiation against you +4. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1dc88694-8519-4fb0-b8c9-c5a823084730
data.value: Radical hostility against a common group: social tests with its members -6 dice; their Negotiation against you +6. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0640207-7965-4f1a-a28c-0dd5e24d2d8c
data.value: Bias against a narrowly defined group: social tests with its members -2 dice; their Negotiation against you +2. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.53ddd66b-ad89-43eb-9174-cbff6ed2a9c3
data.value: Open prejudice against a narrowly defined group: social tests with its members -4 dice; their Negotiation against you +4. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.100cf04a-51e5-477a-a57c-2dae699f7f04
data.value: Radical hostility against a narrowly defined group: social tests with its members -6 dice; their Negotiation against you +6. Other groups are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41cc3e26-ae55-4e28-bd6a-b08866c21424
data.value: Choose one Matrix action that requires a test. Add two dice whenever you perform that action. This does not improve all Matrix skills or actions that have no test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.823eb204-c155-45a9-bb9a-98dcbe17a707
data.value: Choose one home-territory benefit, such as friendly neighbors, hiding places or local knowledge. Only the selected benefit applies, not every local bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8d558134-210d-4c96-b487-021a44409075
data.value: Agree on one natural disease or toxin with the GM. One exposure per 6 hours is harmless; further exposures cause normal damage with half-time recovery. Excludes magical agents. You can still transmit disease.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce7634aa-0729-423d-bc38-d6f56416b904
data.value: Choose one synthetic disease or toxin, not all artificial agents. One exposure per 6 hours is harmless; further exposures cause normal damage with half-time recovery. Excludes magical agents. You can still carry infection.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c067baa6-0dfa-4783-a0c8-0873564f0308
data.value: One chosen spirit type grants extra service and easier Binding, even outside your tradition; no guaranteed obedience. Excludes watchers and constructed minions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8ec5c9bb-aeb9-42f2-a436-a60f764adfe4
data.value: See normally in partial or dim light. These lighting penalties disappear, but total darkness still blocks this sense. This is not heat vision and does not remove other visibility penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.02e76a38-304e-4a0e-93a3-ad2938306afc
data.value: See infrared heat patterns. Improve Light and Visibility conditions by one step before determining their penalties. This is not a flat Perception bonus or immunity to darkness, fog or smoke; thermal smoke can defeat it.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0e741331-d776-4be8-abc5-4101228abdef
data.value: Enables Magic, Sorcery, Conjuring, Enchanting, astral perception and projection. Your creation option determines starting Magic and included skills or spells; this aptitude does not grant every skill, spell or adept Power Points.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4adeb2d4-e42e-4b7a-9a5d-3df325ae59a5
data.value: Choose exactly one group: Sorcery, Conjuring or Enchanting; the others remain unavailable. You can perceive astrally but cannot project. Counterspelling requires Sorcery. Starting Magic and skills depend on your creation option.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9e50dbab-8a5d-430e-83b0-731cce142848
data.value: This pixie trait permits astral perception, not projection. While active, mundane physical tasks lose two dice and astral beings can affect you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.59d9baa1-6705-49e8-940b-ea42ffc02692
data.value: An eligible Nosferatu can imitate remembered voices or sounds, not appearances. Listeners may detect the imitation; older sounds require a memory test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8dbc6b92-18a7-4007-b37f-295d21f8ab82
data.value: An eligible Nosferatu can sustain a telekinetic hand within sight. Test hits set the hand's Strength and Agility, not your own attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dda02333-10e3-4295-9392-691ff3a7bd4a
data.value: Agree a binding moral code with the GM. It restricts killing or demands protecting others; violations can cost Karma and expose your identity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.69984296-4057-4a0f-964e-a0efb4bfc7ce
data.value: Past IC or BTL damage leaves neurological aftereffects. VR, BTL and the responsible IC can trigger symptoms; recovery also requires medical treatment.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f446f88c-26aa-496a-aa78-ed478bf0875f
data.value: Act early in the opening Initiative Pass, but surprise still applies and other initiative-boosting effects can compete.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cf3a62e1-8a41-413e-a679-30c8d1b5a0c1
data.value: The GM warns you before an action they judge foolish, up to your Edge rating in warnings per session. This is advice, not automatic success, immunity to consequences or extra dice; you still decide what to do.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d5eaa4c0-7f7c-4eb2-a708-bed460914d0a
data.value: When the GM rewards an exceptionally daring action with recovered Edge, recover 2 points instead of 1. This does not raise your Edge maximum or reward every risky action automatically; the GM decides what qualifies.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.75c24a3e-f5f9-47e4-947f-e461bac0e82f
data.value: Matrix searches struggle to trace your chosen real or eligible fake SIN; other identities remain unprotected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e30d8c76-968d-4f05-9635-5cb18ca43836
data.value: Criminals the GM considers susceptible are easier to intimidate; respectable citizens treat you with prejudice during Etiquette tests.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7a468691-1362-439a-a096-76da6933b24c
data.value: Gain low-light vision but suffer daylight glare. Augmenting or replacing these eyes removes the quality without a Karma refund.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fd78fa11-5ab6-40db-bdb8-9fd722b08054
data.value: Accurate timekeeping and improved rhythmic Performance, plus an extra Free Action each Action Phase—not an extra attack.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9567f663-b56e-4038-9e15-78c963171fc6
data.value: Makes rituals targeting you harder to seal and easier to resist, including beneficial rituals; does not affect ordinary spells.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e518d74e-9e63-42fe-be47-2e37c461d21b
data.value: Your family name helps with minor local figures but makes you identifiable. Requires a national or full corporate SIN; no blanket legal immunity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.16f138ec-2a6a-4cc3-a5a9-3c12b0fb9689
data.value: Improves your reputation within one chosen group; it grants neither universal Street Cred nor a bonus to every social test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.da834cdb-bb3f-4866-a7f6-755d9d17c62b
data.value: Grants exceptional reputation within one chosen group, stronger than Solid Rep; it is not universal fame or a blanket social bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c0f1c43c-7e50-4a84-ad0d-a0bc28f77836
data.value: Read quickly for general meaning; finding details still takes effort, and you do not gain perfect recall.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.60972204-7dc5-4882-be7d-781f533dabef
data.value: Resist harmful biofeedback, including black IC and dumpshock, with one extra die per level. This does not increase Matrix armor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.af460f42-c0d2-4f7d-8b80-8e71d19b5aac
data.value: Spirits resist summoning more strongly but arrive one Force stronger on success; the summoning itself uses the declared Force.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3fd458df-fd47-4c62-9235-1af27eed2928
data.value: Reduce terrain modifiers on Vehicle tests by 1, never below 0. This eases difficult terrain; it does not create a bonus on clear terrain or increase your vehicle's Handling or Speed.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84d4acee-d58a-43dc-bea7-90cb133fbc76
data.value: Fatigue develops twice as quickly. Accumulating fatigue progressively worsens action penalties, Social Limit and resistance to further exhaustion.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5c5dd94f-8ad2-4fb2-bbe6-26d18e0da436
data.value: A hidden past mistake harms interactions with those who know it and invites blackmail. Exposure adds Notoriety and forces a Karma buyoff.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.81f51f6b-672f-477b-b84a-10b602d714e0
data.value: Neurological blindness impairs perception and combat; cybereyes cannot fix it. Any existing astral perception remains usable, with its usual physical-action penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.56ed0031-cf9b-427c-978f-0a766ac2181d
data.value: Your character risks unpredictable death each session. Ordinary Karma buyoff is unavailable; exceptional survival may require permanently sacrificing all current Edge.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cf66af29-b4ff-4931-bc0b-5c5b6006e978
data.value: Below Middle Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below Middle, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d63f2467-1b76-4f7b-adef-bfced240109e
data.value: Below High Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below High, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bf0f580e-ca90-40e7-8ca1-018bacad9bbc
data.value: Below Luxury Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below Luxury, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8bca877e-42e5-4ff7-92ec-4c83f4cadb86
data.value: Glitches on Social tests become critical glitches, even with hits; ordinary failed rolls and non-social tests are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4d435a24-f8f9-456d-83c1-6fecb217cf67
data.value: Pursuing your personal quest temporarily strengthens Willpower, but resisting a relevant lead is difficult even when it endangers allies.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fae6e95c-f71b-47e5-8cb4-696f2af2bf22
data.value: You risk too much for cherished gear; its permanent loss temporarily impairs related tests unless you buy off this drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9056baa6-ed79-4f28-a199-36093d99555f
data.value: Triggers roughly every other run can cause temporary incapacitation unless resisted.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41d447d7-5ea0-45f9-8b9d-16b5c9ec8937
data.value: Triggers at least once per session can cause temporary incapacitation unless resisted.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b86cdb32-7c3a-404b-94c1-cafe8ccad060
data.value: Better than Squatter housing temporarily lowers all Mental attributes, until a full day back at Squatter or Street level.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dca0897f-532a-43ab-8796-4ef761e829af
data.value: Paralyzed legs require accessible mobility and costlier living or vehicle adaptations. Astral and Matrix abilities are unaffected; corrective surgery also requires Karma buyoff.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3e255d71-c126-40a6-a6f6-44bd17d019e4
data.value: Your distinctive calling card helps investigators connect you to jobs and track you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cb3afab7-03ab-400f-bb67-5a854b24418b
data.value: Cybereye-compatible reduced grade. Your skin remains sun-sensitive: halve the interval between sun-exposure resistance tests. Replacing your eyes does not remove this remaining drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.30eb56ed-b154-4748-a11f-415f03392113
data.value: Light and glare hinder vision; sunlight harms you sooner. Cybereyes require a prior Karma downgrade, taking precedence over other Karma spending.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1209249d-4600-46a7-833c-87d14f719b5e
data.value: You retain practical abilities despite lost memories; the GM holds forgotten Knowledge skills, which cost Karma to recover.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1f03322a-ef16-4495-9bdb-824006c41aad
data.value: The GM controls your forgotten history and hidden character details; regaining full control requires story progress and a Karma buyoff.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8fc3e769-ea71-41e1-968c-600d507cdf94
data.value: 10 weekly work hours earn ¥1,000 monthly; requires a SIN (fake rating four or higher), and repeated absence risks job, pay and reputation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4294e480-4299-41e5-9336-50a98ec14bbf
data.value: 20 weekly work hours earn ¥2,500 monthly; requires a SIN (fake rating four or higher), and repeated absence risks job, pay and reputation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.12b6f08b-5513-4dfd-840d-fd43595d15b8
data.value: 40 weekly work hours earn ¥5,000 monthly; requires a SIN (fake rating four or higher), and repeated absence risks job, pay and reputation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2b4dd1b1-b806-44e3-9067-65dc39c82d13
data.value: Borrow starting funds with 150% debt and 10% monthly interest. Missed payments cause lasting injury; replacing or buying off the quality still requires repayment.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.43cab487-f5f7-4fc1-bc61-c011c3aa3a67
data.value: Stress can reactivate a former cover identity. During an episode, your runner identity and its skills become unavailable; the GM controls the alternate identity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.136cb6e9-0353-4324-9671-1ee176c5aeef
data.value: Lose 2 dice on all Perception tests, including astral and Matrix perception. This grade does not raise their thresholds. It changes test pools, not learned skill ratings.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.26fe2c36-f6cc-4f97-ae1b-5d5eb3be2315
data.value: Lose 2 dice on all Perception tests, including astral and Matrix perception, and increase their thresholds by 1. Both drawbacks apply; this is not a four-dice penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3b2624fe-1d4d-47ba-a663-3ca21323f28c
data.value: No assassination jobs. Violence, including nonlethal attacks, only to defend against an ongoing attack on you, allies or bystanders.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ab5142e6-c8d7-4035-86da-dcdcc2fa46cc
data.value: Reject all violence; breaking this commitment harms mental performance, with lasting consequences possible. Believing you killed someone makes the penalties worse.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce01db25-465b-4d13-b091-055496f3a5c4
data.value: Megacorporations hold identifying records about you. Their investigators gain advantages when identifying or locating you; incompatible with Erased.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.04b68abc-0f9d-4fe9-8b41-82d7b9c95e2e
data.value: Dense AR or sensory enhancements can trigger temporary seizures. Reducing sensory input can prevent exposure, but hiding required identity broadcasts has consequences.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1e3d8aff-c31c-41f9-8c62-e3332cac79fa
data.value: A bounty attracts hunters and betrayal. Ending the threat still requires a Karma buyoff to remove this drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3659b016-5511-4cdb-a9f3-ce2ecfba4513
data.value: Exposure to a rare trigger mildly hinders all actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.255ba2d3-6fbd-4b89-8131-c10f96e70d32
data.value: A rare trigger strongly hinders all actions and may force you to flee unless you resist.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e929cc4a-0973-4c55-9ca9-a925b0d7d463
data.value: A rare trigger severely hinders all actions; failed resistance forces sustained flight.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ff42593b-e1da-406e-aa10-cd90ef2629f5
data.value: Exposure to a frequent trigger mildly hinders all actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1c293ee1-c2e3-4e82-9ee6-91425955f250
data.value: A frequent trigger strongly hinders all actions and may force you to flee unless you resist.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.10b0e391-6cb4-46ba-a357-570ffa2eba69
data.value: A frequent trigger severely hinders all actions; failed resistance forces sustained flight.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5adbea9d-7b48-4bc9-9941-31df54b02804
data.value: You struggle to stop boasting, risking demands to prove exaggerated achievements.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.68399920-e3ff-4d17-a69a-0265c57422ab
data.value: Danger tempts you toward the riskiest choice; giving in briefly improves your Initiative score, not your Initiative dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.62de8226-b9a9-4065-9e82-b9ac4d4d027a
data.value: You struggle to let insults go; delaying retaliation does not remove the urge to seek harsher revenge.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.83e2a9b7-e06e-494e-95d3-c6e554d9928e
data.value: Once fighting, retreat takes self-control while opponents remain able to fight—even when you are losing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f356d63f-1782-4952-aca2-bc04e2cd6c60
data.value: Natural eyesight adds 1 die to Perception and treats range penalties as one category nearer. Incompatible with electronic vision enhancements or cyberware/bioware eye augmentation or replacement.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f8f216b5-1c29-467d-9fb5-c9812408203d
data.value: Choose Artisan or Performance: that skill gains 1 die. Your Street Cred increases by 2 only among artists who know your reputation. Choose this quality once; it does not grant a specialization.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.624fa943-c0a1-44ee-8cd8-3aef4bea3f4b
data.value: After creation, lower Active and Knowledge skill ranks cost less Karma to improve, but advancing higher ranks costs more.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3564b678-7721-4a8d-ac79-1600cf92dc14
data.value: Unaugmented reflexes give +1 Initiative rating, +1 Initiative die and +1 die to Defense tests. The Initiative benefits do not stack with technological, chemical or magical enhancements.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d6c7389c-d6cf-42b1-b3f2-3466d5a5d485
data.value: Languages take half as long to learn and gain 1 die on tests. At creation, language points buy twice as much. In Career, each language increase to rating 3 or higher costs 1 less Karma.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dc7a0c59-5f9c-4ba9-8b63-aaf442472673
data.value: A skilled contact offers free teaching in one chosen skill or skill group, not free skill ranks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0334f054-7d44-443c-a14b-372ba86ff03f
data.value: Skills in the Influence group gain 1 die. Your Social Limit rises by 2 only when the situation involves trusting you, not for every Social test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f8af38e2-e79a-44f9-8e72-57aba35b7056
data.value: Single-target direct combat spells deal 2 more damage but cause 2 more Drain. This does not improve indirect or area spells. Requires the Magician or Aspected Magician quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.df4cfe8b-3394-4ac8-b5c8-fda04701de17
data.value: You cannot read, complicating social, device and knowledge-skill use. Reading-dependent learning remains restricted or costlier until you learn to read and buy off the quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fc31eb53-28a3-46cb-af10-982fca829e34
data.value: You hear nothing: audio-only Perception automatically fails. General Perception loses 2 dice; Surprise loses 3. The GM can apply further situational penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6a0a61f0-4b14-410e-9c3c-4c88a4592277
data.value: Contacts shun you, and new connections withdraw. Discover the GM's hidden reason and resolve it; then buy off this drawback or replace it with one of equal value.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dab93ad4-bc28-4f67-a3f7-209ba893c7fb
data.value: Worsens light/glare penalties, not normal lighting. Corrective implants require buying off this drawback; other eye-related qualities are incompatible.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4e2763ca-e042-4cad-996b-1b472c5426ca
data.value: Distrust costs 2 dice on Social tests with unfamiliar people or contacts whose Loyalty is below 4. You conceal where you live and must relocate every few months. This is not a penalty when dealing with trusted, familiar people.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.34965554-9252-4b37-b40b-c904e8034d03
data.value: Name the person or group in your feud. Encountering that enemy requires Composure (3); failure makes you provoke violence. Defeating the enemy does not erase the drawback: buy it off, or a new enemy continues the feud.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.eeb2ed52-dd4a-4961-83e2-d707530ed193
data.value: Grants High Pain Tolerance 1, but each day begins with 1 Physical damage box. Healing is possible; the character's compulsion seeks to restore that damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8fa3b253-1e6f-439d-940e-f48a1d8959c8
data.value: HMHVV-II carrier: bodily-fluid exposure requires disease resistance. Immune only to this strain. Social tests lose 2 dice against people aware of your status. Notoriety increases by 1 per strain.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3fc02bdc-1f3f-448c-8e8c-d1869ac4fcfc
data.value: HMHVV-III carrier: bodily-fluid exposure requires disease resistance. Immune only to this strain. Social tests lose 2 dice against people aware of your status. Notoriety increases by 1 per strain.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6509ce7a-a453-4941-9bfa-ec0fe48c6d40
data.value: All-round sight aids visual awareness and Surprise; tests while moving and distant shots suffer. Eye modifications remove it; its unusual appearance can provoke prejudice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f368f4c5-6d8e-4bf0-9567-f6ba8367678f
data.value: A second heart doubles the time between fatigue damage from exertion or extreme temperatures. It does not add dice to Athletics. A synthacardium can augment the primary heart only.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8c434958-fce8-45d3-88a5-b0f6f8ca58b0
data.value: Hear infrasound below normal hearing; sound-based Perception limit +1. Always active, with no frequency filter: otherwise inaudible noise can overwhelm you. Incompatible with earware.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bbabf58c-e3b7-49c0-be8f-29f7d8011814
data.value: Hear ultrasound above normal hearing; sound-based Perception limit +1. Always active, with no frequency filter: otherwise inaudible noise can overwhelm you. Incompatible with earware.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cb8ee404-fe6d-4697-9adf-1e41b14355cb
data.value: Skin slowly blends into the background, concealing you while still and uncovered; movement or changed surroundings spoils it. Excludes other dermal modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.02a5832b-6521-4be0-a025-f320e345ca81
data.value: Skin follows background colours: observers lose 2 visual Perception dice while you move, 4 while still. Clothing must preserve concealment. Incompatible with other dermal modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.195f183e-8c42-49cb-bfce-fe84bb9a9964
data.value: Breathe air and water. Air-adapted gills halve fatigue-test intervals underwater; breathing air has no added fatigue penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d10f48e4-5587-4ecf-ba8e-f7de16fe6a2a
data.value: Breathe air and water. Water-adapted gills halve fatigue-test intervals in air; breathing underwater has no added fatigue penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1cf04f79-0d0a-4c61-b166-d1c95b78ebfb
data.value: Breathe air or water equally well, switching automatically. Unlike the partial gill variants, neither environment shortens fatigue-test intervals.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.35103093-5f41-4d42-a2b5-6fbb64f627b1
data.value: Non-hostile presence improves social tests and limits, except Intimidation tests; Distinctive Style also makes you easier to identify and track.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.32c427cf-2f0b-4cbc-a1bd-5dc97ba5e9c6
data.value: Enlarged ears sharpen hearing: gain 1 die on sound-based Perception tests. This is a hearing bonus, not a bonus to every kind of perception.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2f080d13-92d7-4b16-9ee6-93b5a89206e4
data.value: Natural, ordinary-looking eyes see clearly even by starlight. This is low-light vision, not sight in total darkness. Incompatible with replacement eyes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.210401d7-57fa-4260-9517-2725689a509e
data.value: Reflective catlike eyes see clearly by starlight, but their slit pupils make your altered appearance obvious and can affect social encounters. Not sight in total darkness; incompatible with replacement eyes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fd346177-3791-44c0-af8c-7cf176fc9aa3
data.value: Grants natural heat-sensitive vision, like that of a dwarf or troll. Use thermographic visibility conditions; this is not an unconditional Perception bonus or the ability to see through walls.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4390735f-54fa-44a5-bce7-d23a67427f25
data.value: A protective eye membrane lets you see underwater as though wearing swimming goggles or a diving mask. Water clarity and lighting still matter; this does not grant underwater breathing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1d9239a1-0e58-4779-873d-5b8677865806
data.value: Arctic adaptation: Survival and climate-fatigue resistance gain 1 die in extreme cold, but lose 1 in desert heat. Incompatible with dermal plating, skin modifications and a suprathyroid gland.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.850ac6a8-4264-4b7f-bf75-04e1c768b411
data.value: Desert adaptation: Survival and climate-fatigue resistance gain 1 die in desert heat, but lose 1 in extreme cold. Incompatible with dermal plating, skin modifications and a suprathyroid gland.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3e80d1e0-ae6a-4059-8a49-ae97547b3384
data.value: Adhesive palms let you use assisted climbing speeds whenever your hands are uncovered. Gloves block this benefit. You still make the required climbing tests; this does not guarantee success.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9b8a9ecc-295f-4764-b5d8-0a3fb317d9b8
data.value: Gripping toes give +2 dice for non-tumbling Gymnastics, climbing and zero-gravity movement. Use bare feet or adapted footwear; ordinary, unsuitable shoes reduce the bonus to +1.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.51027aca-c1db-470a-afa4-d28cc219152f
data.value: A natural chest or belly pouch stores small items like a smuggling compartment, with Concealability −6. It helps hide the contents; it does not make them impossible to discover.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.67767d53-56f0-4b66-b7ef-5ff6319ea551
data.value: Sense electrical sources within Essence metres. Simple Action: Perception + Intuition [Mental], affected by Noise. More hits distinguish source type, location, augmentation and orientation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.54c7952d-24b2-489e-9597-3430dfff6207
data.value: Sense wireless signals within Essence metres. Simple Action: Perception + Intuition [Mental], affected by Noise. More hits reveal devices, nanites or technomancers; this grants no control over them.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.493450e1-b88b-441b-b7ee-bdecf5a99d2d
data.value: Grasp objects awkwardly with your trunk or use it as a physical melee weapon, without extra attacks. Its conspicuous appearance can provoke prejudice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bf416ac2-75b2-4907-8b15-1447784b5851
data.value: Animals and paranormal critters within 5 metres react fearfully or aggressively. Tests to control, calm or pacify them lose 2 dice. In combat, critters prefer attacking you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.acd06d4f-7f09-4d80-8bab-006b680392a2
data.value: A single eye reduces depth perception, hindering combat and precision work. A cybereye cannot restore binocular processing; incompatible with Third Eye.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ddc04b8e-b0f7-485d-9ab7-dee1110133fd
data.value: Displaced facial features: −2 Perception dice. Double the usual metagenic social modifiers. Surgical correction requires buying off this drawback first.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.35279341-3611-439a-9550-8227b306198f
data.value: Conspicuous feathers provide no armour. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Your appearance can provoke prejudice. Incompatible with Scales and Unusual Hair.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7618be2b-b4c1-4f7c-905b-7698cc2e744e
data.value: Insectlike features provide no flight or improved vision. Strangers begin Hostile, fearing insect spirits; combatants may target you first. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0ece5812-aa89-484b-b899-f02ac961a417
data.value: Your hair changes colour with your emotions. Observers who understand the colours gain 2 dice to Judge Intentions against you. Incompatible with other hair modifications, Feathers and Scales.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0887f45-c0b1-4a5c-bd17-d73450287621
data.value: Your body favours night or twilight activity and daytime sleep. During daylight hours, all Mental attributes decrease by 1, not just test dice. Incompatible with Photometabolism.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.873d8045-853f-4797-9f08-1a1eac388af0
data.value: Shedding scales offer no armor and make identification or tracking easier, with possible prejudice. Incompatible with skin-related qualities and bioware.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0152c5a-b959-43f2-825e-801e5ac07466
data.value: Your smell aids tracking and, unmasked, hinders social tests; stress worsens both, and perfume only masks the ordinary smell.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c57c9407-7ac6-4061-abab-7735c8bd69b4
data.value: Obvious skin colours or patterns make you memorable and can provoke prejudice. Others gain 2 dice on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Incompatible with bioware skin augmentations.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dba6c764-3851-4d8e-97ce-344f45c8d771
data.value: A forehead eye gives no general vision bonus, but preserves depth perception when one eye closes. Even closed, it can be noticed with Perception (2). Incompatible with Cyclopean Eye; your appearance can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.69a61e8c-238e-4ef9-8847-6271ed260a62
data.value: Unusual hair colour, texture or growth makes you conspicuous. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Incompatible with natural or artificial hair modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4e35cd80-5a2e-431b-aafc-5a39a9e17f38
data.value: A nonfunctional tail disrupts balance: lose 1 die on Physical tests involving movement or balance, such as jumping, climbing and running. Incompatible with Functional Tail or artificial tails. Your appearance can provoke prejudice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8236f10b-345c-44f5-b0b1-648004f24d3f
data.value: Your aura disrupts nearby magic, including your own; lingering can spread the disturbance, with its extent requiring GM agreement.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.95ba1f65-34c0-4f6e-9440-40e860278342
data.value: Emotional stress can trigger rage that endangers allies, boosts physical attributes, impairs mental attributes and activates an implanted adrenaline pump.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.96b4cfc7-ddf6-4828-8393-7625b0564bd1
data.value: Your skin or hair glows in dim light or darkness, reducing others' visibility penalty to spot you by 1 level. If you have low-light vision, the glow also improves your nearby visibility by 1 level. Normal lighting hides the glow.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8b0eb8a7-fc44-4452-bfd6-db8ee531bc0d
data.value: A soft, tentacled head and upper torso lose 3 dice when resisting damage to those regions. This is not a penalty to every damage-resistance test. The conspicuous appearance can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.006409d3-cc04-4195-8569-b81d73ccb1a2
data.value: Cold weakens physical activity and can cause coma; thermal-only observers have more difficulty detecting or attacking you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.33a1a0ed-20b8-4ddd-9070-2b460a5455b7
data.value: Long residence bonds you to a neighborhood, improving outdoor skills and sometimes healing. Local troubles cause allergy-like symptoms; moving requires renewed adjustment.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.31108c89-a67c-47d4-a757-db4e22e2f607
data.value: Choose a manufacturer: tests using its gear gain 1 die; tests using other manufacturers' gear lose 1 die. This covers the maker's range, not just one product.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.348d7043-7a1c-498f-85eb-3339be9941d1
data.value: Choose a product model: tests using it gain 1 die; other models of the same equipment type lose 1 die. Unrelated equipment types are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.98644894-e3a4-41f2-9b7e-91feb74d0334
data.value: Learn one chosen martial-arts technique without learning its associated style. This grants the technique, not an entire style or every technique in it. The chosen move's effects still depend on that technique.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1675810d-0f77-42f9-848a-eaa929cb3a20
data.value: Called Shot penalties are reduced by 2 dice. All other Ranged Attack actions lose 1 die. Precision shots improve at the expense of ordinary shooting; this is not a general ranged-attack bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.da4f7e4a-0e7e-45e6-a872-643bdecb183e
data.value: Radiation causes less fatigue, not slower deadly exposure; contamination persists twice as long and threatens others. Incompatible with Rad-Tolerant.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.01bba489-52a2-4a80-845e-61905a970626
data.value: Double the exposure time before developing Blighted. Radiation environments count 1 severity step lower for fatigue. This is resistance, not radiation immunity; it cannot be combined with Radiation Sponge.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8826405e-a995-4687-b7c8-4e1e51fef3f0
data.value: Physical actions gain 1 die whenever gravity differs from normal Earth gravity. No bonus in ordinary terrestrial gravity, and no bonus to unrelated Mental actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8d2b32ec-2ddf-40dd-a29b-bf2e85a3d8ca
data.value: Under stress or when plans go wrong, resisting your urge to start a fight requires a test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f810fb60-8e1f-4111-a4f3-b652e91693ca
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: Physical actions −1 die this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94cbe9bc-fabc-4126-81f8-3e31c7ed85f8
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: all actions −1 die this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6be0022f-f8c8-4c51-808c-d339d3e8fecb
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: Physical actions −2 dice, others −1 this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e7c16580-6705-4a93-a9be-dbea90efd2eb
data.value: Physical actions lose 2 dice when gravity differs from normal Earth gravity. No penalty under ordinary terrestrial gravity. If your campaign does not encounter altered gravity, taking this drawback requires GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ab72b0fb-5a64-4d5e-9e23-2fdf548a7f53
data.value: Chase Actions gain 2 dice, whether you are pursuing another vehicle or trying to escape. This improves chase tests, not every driving roll or the vehicle's Speed attribute.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ef6796eb-6559-4f22-bfa6-7e6571a3690d
data.value: Discounts purchases in one chosen vehicle class; available once per class. Availability restrictions and price adjustments still apply.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1b40cda8-97e1-40bf-827b-0d38c3ba6dfc
data.value: Tests using skills in the Engineering group gain 1 die. This helps mechanical work without increasing learned skill ratings, giving free repairs or improving every Technical skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5bcfc0fc-1e46-4ba9-a48c-7b623e9ab8db
data.value: Pilot tests gain 1 die while travelling at Speed 3 or higher, or 4 for aircraft. You must be inside the vehicle or jacked in; ordinary remote piloting does not qualify. This does not increase the vehicle's maximum speed.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fe34b084-2368-4f8d-bb91-689ee22e9380
data.value: Vehicle Stunt tests gain 2 dice. The bonus is for stunt manoeuvres with vehicles, not every Pilot test or attacks made from a vehicle.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.311421e2-a71e-4f06-a15a-9fbc53247376
data.value: Harder to spot vehicles using your chosen Pilot skill, including directly controlled drones; autonomous drones gain nothing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9038578e-6a7c-43d7-ae51-324738a1a9d1
data.value: Nausea from rapid acceleration or high vehicle speed affects passengers too; recovery takes time after the motion settles.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.22c624b8-89f4-4c0d-ab19-c84ca204e2a5
data.value: Directing 4 or more moving vehicles or drones overwhelms you: Pilot tests for their movement lose 2 dice. Autopilot-controlled units still count because their incoming data distracts you. Stationary units do not trigger this rule.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.237eb46a-a012-4e0b-808a-80eda1c1a586
data.value: Learn magical tattooing in 2 weeks. Existing Artificing can create tattoo foci; existing Quickening or Anchoring can attach spells to tattoos. This technique does not grant those skills or metamagics, nor a free focus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.34d7e834-4fbe-49b1-86e8-a9ff354fd972
data.value: Extra reagents beyond those setting limits improve Summoning; Binding uses fewer reagents and gains dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94a4cc04-d856-418f-ac60-165f327433d5
data.value: Summoning fails without extra reagents beyond those setting limits; Binding costs more reagents and loses dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1b5acdf3-66ae-4ed7-b5fa-614668721774
